label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 28
title: MVP: E2E pipeline view shows all stages/phases, agents + grouped sub-agents, selected tier and model per agent
body:
Owner requirement: the E2E pipeline view must depict ALL stages/phases of ALL agents, with each agent's SUB-AGENTS grouped under their parent, and must show per agent (a) the TIER currently selected and (b) the MODEL each agent is actually running. Data sources: config/model-tier.json + per-project products/

/model-tier.json override + config/agent-hierarchy.json (parent->sub) + core/orchestrator/model_router.py describe_tiers/resolve. Extends BI-0027 (E2E workflow views) and BI-0018 (depict configs).
